Random Team Generator

Split names into random fair teams by team count or team size, using a Fisher-Yates shuffle with round-robin distribution.

–
Players
–
Teams

📖 How to use

  1. Paste one name per line.
  2. Choose team count or team size and set the number.
  3. Press Shuffle teams — copy or download the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the teams fair / balanced?

Yes. Every name is shuffled with the Fisher-Yates algorithm and dealt round-robin, so teams differ by at most one player.

Can I choose team size instead of team count?

Pick the mode you want: a fixed number of teams, or a fixed team size (the tool computes how many teams that makes).

Can I re-shuffle?

Press Shuffle again — every press re-randomizes with a fresh shuffle.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
